label: Weak ordered reading and recipient willing hold together in a finite sample
paraphrase: Analyst witness, unattributed. In a two-being sample (true is the willing GOD_4 and only rational being; false is distinct, non-rational, in act and caused by true), the weak ordered-love reading, CausalExistenceWilling at the same recipient-directed willing relation, and the existence of that caused non-rational effect all hold, while the strong exclusive variant fails. A finite structural interpretation, not a model of divine willing.
